title: The beaded pocketbook and Lorraine Gillespie
summary: She overheard Lorraine and Dizzy discussing a pocketbook she could not sell, and returned it to Hazel Scott.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: They were saying one day, "Has she given it to you/yet?" I was coming down the hall and I heard Lorraine say, "No." He said, "Well, I gave her some bla-bla..." I had a pocketbook that Hazel had brought back from Paris and it was worth, oh, $300, a beaded pocketbook. She gave it to me to raise money, Hazel Scott. Lorraine liked it but I didn't know whether I should give it - I wanted to give it to Lorraine. So that night I called Father and I said - and Father said, "Yes, they're your friends, Mary." Lorraine called me and she said, "Guess what? I was just talking to Dizzy about you. Dizzy asked if you still had the pocketbook. I said Mary's not going to give that pocketbook; Mary's honest and she knows she has to raise money with it and I don't have the money to buy it." So what I finally did, I returned it to Hazel because I couldn't - it was new, a beautiful pocketbook and I couldn't raise money.
